exposure: Furostanol saponin glycoside based standardized fenugreek seed extract (Fenu-FG) at 250, 500, and 1000 mg/kg/day
outcome: Numbers and weights of corpora lutea
cohort: Pregnant female Wistar rats were administered Fenu-FG during gestational days 5-19.
finding: Prenatal oral exposure of Fenu-FG to pregnant female rats during organogenesis showed no significant maternal or developmental toxicity (fetotoxicity or teratogenicity) at doses up to 1000 mg/kg, with a No Observed Adverse Effect Level (NOAEL) greater than 1000 mg/kg.
gest_age: Exposure period: Gestational days 5-19; Examination: Gestational day 20
